reasoning: This is a UI control glyph for exiting picture-in-picture mode (expanding a corner mini-player back to the full window). As pure interface chrome representing a display state toggle rather than a real-world object or common task subject, it has almost no use in personal to-do lists outside of niche software UI tickets.
